_comment: Field items carried in the party satchel and used from the quick menu (issue #6). target: 'hurt' = a standing hero below full HP, 'downed' = a downed hero, 'party' = everyone standing (no target to pick). heal: HP restored ('revive' items bring a downed hero back at revive_pct of max HP). power: fills the attack gauge. start: how many Hollowmark's stores put back in the satchel after every mission (you keep any extra you found). drop: chance a defeated enemy leaves one behind.

tonic.name: Bitter Tonic
tonic.desc: Restores 25 HP to one hero. Tastes like a bad decision.

salts.name: Smelling Salts
salts.desc: Gets a downed hero back up at half HP, enemies or not.

draught.name: Black Draught
draught.desc: Whole party: attack gauges full and 8 HP each. Mostly coffee.
